svg.title: FIG-17 Target H743 Flash RAM boundary Selected V / three Cache-off profiles; physical HIL not executed
svg.desc: One authored TOML + reviewed facts Immutable IR; selected-only static objects; External maintenance caller Schedule, join other bus masters, own recovery; Cold typed factory Return the existing immutable Flash face; Flash face Shared read-only ops + private context; Explicit Platform start / stop Prepare bytes; retain failed cleanup; One physical Flash owner / fixed generated workspace; Cold provider admission Exact binding, input, layout and caller context; Cold RAM preparation Validate LOAD / RUN; copy and prove readiness; Assembly entry on private MSP Save CPU state; protect MPU captures in r8-r11; C RAM phase: fixed workspace / MMIO Publish private VTOR; guard; pulse; drain; restore MPU; Independent assembly return gate Read back idle / LOCK / effects / captured MPU Restore linker-known VTOR; prove readback; Assembly bridge restores caller CPU state Only after the return gate succeeds; One embedded selector-effect ledger Set before RNR write; clear after exact restore / readback; Nonreturning RAM terminal Any unproved capture, cleanup or return condition; supplies admitted code / vectors / private stack; direct call after final admission; protected captures; private MSP established; every returning C path; private VTOR retained; all hardware return checks proved; records selector effects; checks and balances selector effects; capture cannot be proved; settlement cannot be proved; return condition cannot be proved; Fixed FLASH / SCB / MPU registers Both banks idle; LOCK; vector and MPU readback; Existing System TIM2 domain / epoch Deadline observations require valid time; emits selected preparation / cleanup; emits face and shared ops reference; typed identity lookup; existing reference; no preparation; explicit lifecycle call; prepare before use; direct synchronous I/O call; ops(context, ...) call; caller preconditions: masters joined; stack reserve; physical pulse / status / guard / private VTOR; independent readback; fixed VTOR restore; same-domain deadline and epoch observations
